taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-12, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1228.3 | 0.41 | 0.41
2 | 678.3 | 0.50 | 0.91
3 | 2104.5 | 0.76 | 1.67
4 | 3417.4 | 29.87 | 31.54
5 | 3516.3 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as HAA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-12, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note – Station T-12 (Survey Area T)**

Station T-12 features a 5-layer geoelectric section:
- Layer 1 (0.00–0.41 m): 1228.3 Ω·m
- Layer 2 (0.41–0.91 m): 678.3 Ω·m
- Layer 3 (0.91–1.67 m): 2104.5 Ω·m
- Layer 4 (1.67–31.54 m): 3417.4 Ω·m
- Layer 5 (>31.54 m): 3516.3 Ω·m

The resistivity sequence demonstrates an initial decrease followed by a monotonic increase: layers 1-2-3 form an H-type relation (1228.3 > 678.3 < 2104.5 Ω·m), layers 2-3-4 form an A-type relation (678.3 < 2104.5 < 3417.4 Ω·m), and layers 3-4-5 form an A-type relation (2104.5 < 3417.4 < 3516.3 Ω·m). The resulting HAA curve designation matches the on-file classification.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
